artifacts.summary: 11-phase plan collapsing the consequence/compactness/strong-completeness theorem layer onto generic FrameClass declarations, with the Conservativity/ reorganization and C2/C14 manifest extension.

memory_candidates.content: When a Lean repo's per-class theorem copies are collapsed onto generic FrameClass declarations, the phase boundaries must be cut along the actual dependency edges rather than along the work-item numbering. In BimodalLogic task 524 the compactness triangle (item 2) and the shared refutation skeleton (item 3) interleave in both directions: compact_of_strongCompleteness feeds not_strongCompleteness_of_witness, while not_compact_of_witness feeds modelExistence_of_compact. Treating the items as two sequential phases would deadlock. The general pattern: when two work items each supply a lemma the other consumes, split by lemma (all mutually-independent generics in one phase, all the theorems that consume both in the next) instead of by item.
